title: Business school bachelor policies
notes: The current catalog names the James and Gail Ellis School of Business Leadership, formerly Anderson. Keep the institutional college code; this does not rename Banner mappings.

Only common policies and BBA major-status conditions are transcribed here. Course-by-course BBA curriculum remains in the degree-specific files. The college page and existing program snapshot have differences that need comparison.

rules.label: Major-status Phase I credits
rules.statement: Complete the 21-credit BBA Phase I admission block, with transfer work permitted where accepted.
rules.applies_when: All students in this rule set scope.

rules.label: Phase I GPA
rules.statement: The major-status section requires a 2.5 Phase I GPA and C or better in each Phase I course. The graduation section contains a conflicting GPA value; see the case below.
rules.applies_when: All students in this rule set scope.

rules.label: UNM GPA at admission
rules.statement: Continuing students need a 2.0 cumulative UNM GPA; the source gives transfer students a first-semester opportunity to establish 2.5. Preserve the distinct statements.
rules.applies_when: All students in this rule set scope.

rules.label: BBA major transition
rules.statement: The school describes automatic pre-BBA to BBA transition after its Phase I requirements are met. Completion and recorded admission remain separate states for a student evaluator.
rules.applies_when: All students in this rule set scope.

rules.label: School residence
rules.statement: Complete at least 24 credits in residence at the business school, alongside University residence requirements.
rules.applies_when: All students in this rule set scope.

rules.label: Business CR/NC restrictions
rules.statement: Do not apply CR/NC coursework to General Education, prerequisites, upper-division humanities, the school core or a concentration under this school policy.
rules.applies_when: All students in this rule set scope.

rules.label: Core/concentration grades
rules.statement: The school page specifies C-minus or better for school core and concentration courses; Phase I, other prerequisites and Gen Ed have C thresholds. Preserve program-specific stricter rules or conflicts.
rules.applies_when: All students in this rule set scope.

rules.label: Physical education cap
rules.statement: Count no more than one physical-education credit toward the BBA.
rules.applies_when: All students in this rule set scope.

rules.label: Degree total and GPA
rules.statement: Complete 120 degree credits with a cumulative GPA of at least 2.0; the 120-credit total restates the University floor.
rules.applies_when: All students in this rule set scope.

rules.label: Gen Ed
rules.statement: Complete University Gen Ed with the school’s course and grade restrictions. The college page’s remaining-credit subtotal is not a universal extra block.
rules.applies_when: All students in this rule set scope.

rules.label: Graduation application
rules.statement: Apply during the semester before expected graduation under school deadlines.
rules.applies_when: All students in this rule set scope.

attention.statement: The major-status section specifies 2.5; the graduation list literally specifies a Phase I GPA of 5. Do not treat 5 as an executable threshold or silently repair it. The same page repeats MATH 1350 across blocks; curriculum/credit allocation needs a separate program comparison.
